paragraphs.source_en: competitors, he replied, "Absolutely not. We think they're great." Is Repositioning Ethical? In the past advertising was prepared in isolation. That is, you studied the product and its features, and then you prepared advertising which communicated to your customers and prospects the benefits of those features. It didn't make much difference whether the competition offered those features or not. When you run a repositioning campaign, you want to be "fair." That is, you should treat the competition in an ethical way. Ragu was (and still is) the leading spaghetti sauce. Their share, however, has declined substantially because Prego has successfully positioned itself as the "thick" spaghetti sauce. (Prego television commercials compared the two brands by name.)
